campaign_separation: Separate source-pinned six-arm campaigns; a combined160-envelope warm campaign is not admitted. Retries consume the finite envelope budget.

publisher_warmup.audit: Existing resource gate before each native entry; actual inputs, raw returns, CUDA fences and separate attempted/entered/completed/validated counters; exact instance-method restoration in finally.
publisher_warmup.failure: No READY or cold fallback after partial/failed warmup.

bindings: Session, local Gateway, READY, RPC and CLOSED bind the externally selected startup/workload, new source17 and unchanged selected complete CPU weight profile; postwarm full cache/source/geometry/package checks precede READY.
counts: Warmup calls, gateway ingress, forwarded browser envelopes, native backend/system_one/probabilities entries and helper calls remain distinct. API entries are not GPU kernel launches.
timing: Load/cache authentication/warmup/postchecks/total readiness reported separately. Task clock starts after explicit readiness and includes original decode/queue/native/conversion/evidence; compilation or other work inside a task is never subtracted.

root_validation.scope: Pure/fake numerical components and existing owned loopback HTTP tests; no real model/GPU/Modal warm run.

cold_parity.scope: Actual native adapter/wire with fake backend and clock. Byte equality after owned output path normalization only; not a proof of every possible cold execution.
